item.title: SHEIN Distribution Corporation Recalls Pull and Chew Montessori Teething Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
item.company: Sold Online At: SHEIN.com from December 2025 through April 2026 for about $10.
item.brand: Sold Online At: SHEIN.com from December 2025 through April 2026 for about $10.
item.summary: This recall involves Pull & Chew Montessori Teething Toys. The silicone teething toys are green, pink, yellow or blue and have four strings in various colors. The recalled toys are packaged in a clear and white plastic pouch with "BABY PRODUCTS" and "Crafted in Gentle Care" printed on the front. The product SKU (sa25092843915310553, sa2404237092800828, or sa251115653050553503) is printed on the front of the packaging. The manufacturer's name and address, product date, and batch code are printed on the front and back of the packaging.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Pull & Chew Montessori Teething Toys.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled teething toys immediately, take them away from children, and contact SHEIN for a refund. Consumers will be asked to cut the teething toy’s silicone strings and send a photo of the destroyed toy to productrecall@shein.com. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
